|errata_history=This is errata version PC-E1 (version 2 of 4), the PC website card list text (21 July 2012 to 11 January 2013). It is not the current text. * '''Original''' ([[Hidden Fortress]]): Virtual Block 1 release sheet, official text as of 7 December 2009 (slip 126E)<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock1">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock1.pdf#page=9 Virtual Block 1 release sheet] ("Official text as of 7 December 2009"), page 9, slip 126E. Document: the release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB1-126E-Hidden_Fortress.png]]) prints slip number “126E” bottom right.
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): PC website card list, Virtual Block 1 list and Virtual master list, in every archived capture with game text, 21 July 2012 to 11 January 2013<ref name="cl-1210_123">Players Committee website card list (Internet Archive captures): VBlock1Type (Virtual Block 1 list) [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064706/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock1Type.html 21 July 2012], [https://web.archive.org/web/20121211205209/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock1Type.html 11 December 2012], [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111142851/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock1Type.html 11 January 2013]; VMasterType (Virtual master list) [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064754/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VMasterType.html 21 July 2012], [https://web.archive.org/web/20121211203905/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VMasterType.html 11 December 2012], [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111135545/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VMasterType.html 11 January 2013]. Later captures carry no game text.</ref>: “Deploy on table (only at start of game) with up to three systems from outside your deck face-down under here. If non-[Virtual Block 4] Hidden Base on table: Once per game, may deploy a system from here and/or exchange Hidden Base indicator with a system (from parsec 1 to 8) under here. [Immune to Alter]” '''What changed:''' “once per game” is written “Once per game”, with a capital O. The same wording is already in the Players Committee's Holotable card data of 29 May 2010<ref name="cdf-1210_123">[https://github.com/ledwards/swccgvkit/blob/5047de0/db/lightside.cdf Holotable card data file, version 29 May 2010] (Players Committee data, copy on GitHub). Card data is dating evidence only, not a card document.</ref>. Icons written out in words, straight single quotes and credit lines in the list are not changes. The PC website card list was generated from the Players Committee's Holotable card data (research R7, 11 November 2026), so its wording follows that data; it is listed as a version because the PC published it.
* '''PC-E2''' ([[Hidden Fortress (Errata 2)]]): Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB1-L-hiddenfortress-pre.gif]]), on the PC website by 25 February 2013 (server upload date)<ref name="pcimg-Virtual1-Light">Players Committee card image, file <code>cardlists/images/starwars/Virtual1-Light/large/hiddenfortress.gif</code>; the directory listing of this folder (Virtual1-Light) was not captured; the captured Legacy folders (Virtual2, Virtual4, Virtual5, Virtual6, Virtual7) all carry 25-Feb-2013 11:33/11:34, the date the PC rebuilt its image set (research R6, 11 November 2026: these are bulk upload dates, and an image may have been made earlier). Today's copy: https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/legacy/VirtualBlock1-Light/large/hiddenfortress.gif</ref>: “Deploy on table (only at start of game) with up to three systems from outside your deck face-down under here. If non-[Virtual Block 4] Hidden Base on table: once per game, may deploy a system from here and/or exchange Hidden Base indicator with a system (from parsec 1 to 8) under here. [Immune to Alter]” '''What changed:''' the PC card image prints the original release-sheet text of 7 December 2009 again, word for word, after the PC website card list (PC-E1) had published a different text. It is listed as its own version, placed at its upload date (Bill's rulings of 11 November 2026: a PC card image is its own version, placed at its date (here its server upload date), even when its words repeat an earlier version; whatever was published last is current). The date is only the folder's bulk upload date: the image may have been made earlier, so its place in the order is uncertain, but the versioning order follows the upload date. Document: the PC card image is a whole card (art, title bar, lore, icons, frame and the Virtual Block 1 set mark) and prints the number “126E” bottom right, as the release-sheet slip does; its caption bottom left reads “•Rebel Planners (V)”, the label of another card.

Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170705013057/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf#page=24 Internet Archive]</ref>: “Deploy on table (only at start of game) with up to three systems from outside your deck face-down under here. If non-[Virtual Block 4] Hidden Base on table: once per game, may deploy a system from here and/or exchange Hidden Base indicator with a system (from parsec 1 to 8) under here. [Immune to Alter]” '''What changed:''' the Master List prints the original release-sheet text of 7 December 2009 again, word for word. It is the last publication, so it is the current text; it is listed as its own version because it was published (Bill's rulings of 11 November 2026: every publication is a version, even one that repeats an earlier text word for word; whatever was published last is current). The image on its page is the Master List slip ([[:File:VL-history-1210-123-master.png]]). Document: the Master List slip prints no slip number; it prints the errata mark “E” bottom right; it shows the whole card top (title bar and lore) with the slip pasted over the lower part; the label under the slip reads “•Rebel Planners (V)”, the label of another card.
